resources.string: External Web plugins
Import static page plugins. Ordinary pages need no Linux; PRoot pages require local Linux and Python 3. App capabilities require separate confirmation.
PRoot static service
This package exceeds the PRoot startup capacity. Ask its author to reduce the assets or use the ordinary PACKAGE page source.

Opening starts a host-managed static service in the current local distribution; closing releases it. Requires ready Linux and /usr/bin/python3; dependencies are not installed automatically. Compressed assets and authentication must fit a 4 KiB bootstrap packet or startup is refused.

Import external Web plugin?
Names and descriptions are supplied by the plugin, without official endorsement. Import verifies file integrity. It does not open the page or grant app capabilities.
This package requests no app capabilities.
Requests the app package name, Android API and plugin API versions. No credentials, files or device logs are included.

Remove Web plugin?
Remove all imported versions of “%1$s” and invalidate permissions for its open pages.
The plugin is loading, has been upgraded or has been removed. Return to the list and open it again.
Allow plugin to copy this text?
Requests plain-text clipboard writes, with confirmation of the exact text each time. Replaces the current clipboard without reading it.
